findings.text: every node more than NEAR_BAR_BAND below the bar is hold at any fill, including the maximally prescribed node (score 0.0) at a full window — asserted as intended at tests/test_bar.py:90 — while the module's own docstring at reckon/crew/bar.py:4-6 says prescribed work "belongs on the free lane, which is not" finite, and the plan requires "a node recommended to the free lane is asserted to be prescribed" (docs/plans/a-window-paces-the-lane.html:176); no outcome this implementation can return ever recommends a node to the free lane, so that clause of the section has no counterpart in the diff and the module's own stated contract is contradicted by its hold region.

the landing record and the evidence anchor both state "The declared mutation inverts the bar", and the red log's first line matches that; the control declared for this node on its run's live pointer is "make the bar ignore its window-state argument and return send for every window; tests/test_bar.py must fail". These are different mutations with different reddening signatures, so the log on file does not evidence the declared control. Applied myself in a scratch copy whose resolution probe named the scratch module, the declared mutation reddens the file: 7 failed, 6 passed, exit 1 (declared-mutation-rerun.log). So the tests are sensitive and the declaration is achievable, but nothing on file shows that declaration firing, and the same claim is repeated at docs/evidence/archive/a-window-paces-the-lane-landed.html:56.

the assertion that the result carries no routing is a blocklist of ten current fleet lane names over the string values of one constructed instance, so a caller-facing field carrying a lane spelling outside that list would pass it, and the type's own field names are never asserted on.

the clamp branch is exercised by no case: a fill outside zero to one is folded silently into the domain, so a window past its ceiling reads as a full window rather than as a state the caller cannot express, and a regression that removed the clamp would not redden any of the 13 tests.

measure_verdicts.evidence: tests/test_bar.py:44 asserts exactly one public function in the module, and :54-68 honours two score literals and greps the module's import lines for prescription; the module's only imports are __future__ and dataclasses, so no import could reach prescription.

measure_verdicts.clause: monotonic across the whole window domain sampled at many points rather than at transitions
measure_verdicts.evidence: tests/test_bar.py:71-77 samples 201 points over zero to one and asserts strict increase pairwise, which a constant or a wobbly bar fails.
tests/test_bar.py:80-91 asserts bar 0.0 and 1.0 at the two ends and that the verdicts differ between an empty and a service-full window.

measure_verdicts.clause: each of the three recommendations returned at its own boundary, asserted separately
measure_verdicts.evidence: three separate cases at tests/test_bar.py:94, :103 and :113 pin send at margin zero, split at the band edge and hold far below it, and :120 asserts all three outcomes are reachable and distinct.

measure_verdicts.clause: the return value is asserted to be a recommendation carrying no backend name, so a caller cannot read a routing out of it
measure_verdicts.evidence: tests/test_bar.py:131-155 checks every string-valued dataclass field of one instance against a ten-token lane blocklist, so the narrow claim holds for the fleet's current spelling; the closing claim is broader than the assertion, which reads values rather than the type's field names.

measure_verdicts.clause: an orchestrator override in each direction is asserted to be recorded on the result rather than refused
measure_verdicts.evidence: tests/test_bar.py:158 overrides a hold toward send and :168 overrides a send toward hold, and both assert verdict, override, effective and overridden are carried on the result.

measure_verdicts.clause: one fixed node and score is asserted to move from send to hold as the window fills
measure_verdicts.evidence: tests/test_bar.py:178 holds score at 0.50 and asserts send, split, hold at fills 0.00, 0.55 and 1.00, with the three bar values asserted at :192.
